name: Polish patties (kotlety)
assumptions: Yield of 8 based on explicit instruction to divide meat mixture into 8 patties
Total time estimated from instructions: ~8 min onion frying + ~15 min for two batches of patties (6-7 min per side) + ~10-12 min estimated for mixing, soaking, shaping = 35 min
Bread roll classified as containing wheat and gluten
Breadcrumbs classified as containing wheat and gluten
Vegetable oil, onion, garlic, marjoram, and ground beef introduce no additional listed allergens
No vegan/vegetarian/pescatarian compatibility due to ground beef
No gluten-free compatibility due to bread roll and breadcrumbs
No dairy-free compatibility due to milk
instructions:
step 1
Soak the bread roll in the milk so it softens completely. Meanwhile, fry the onion in the oil for around 8 mins or until soft and golden. Add the fried onion to the beef mince along with the egg, garlic, marjoram and some seasoning. Squeeze the excess milk from the bread roll and add it to the mince mixture. Mix everything together and season well.

step 2
Divide the meat into 8 patties. Tip the dried breadcrumbs into a shallow bowl and coat the patties in it, all over. Heat some oil in a deep frying pan and fry the patties in batches on both sides until browned and cooked through, about 6-7 mins on each side.

ingredients.name: Bread Rolls
ingredients.assumptions: Standard white bread roll ~50g each; typical size used in Polish recipes for kotlety.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.assumptions: 120ml semi-skimmed milk; density ~1.02g/ml, all milk is absorbed then excess squeezed out but full amount used in estimate.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium onion chopped (~110g raw); typical size for this recipe quantity.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 100ml vegetable oil for frying onion (density ~0.92g/ml); full amount included as it is part of the cooked mixture even if some remains in pan.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.assumptions: 500g raw ground beef (80/20 lean-to-fat typical for patties); remains ~500g after cooking loss accounted in per-100g values.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.assumptions: 1 large egg (~50g edible portion without shell).

ingredients.name: Marjoram
ingredients.assumptions: Pinch of dried marjoram estimated at 1g for nutrition purposes; plausible small amount in recipe.

ingredients.name: Breadcrumbs
ingredients.assumptions: 75g dried breadcrumbs (plain); full amount used for coating, some may not adhere but all included per recipe.
